title: 054e Dead camel thorn tree in Deadvlei Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg
author: Giles Laurent
description: Dead camel thorn tree (Vachellia erioloba) in Deadvlei, Namibia. The trees in Deadvlei grew approximately 900 years ago when periodic flooding of the Tsauchab River created a fertile marsh, but they died between 600 and 700 years ago after encroaching sand dunes obstructed the water flow.
